milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The spruce trapdoors are the building entrance at spawn-relative (6, 1, 4). The player must navigate near the trapdoor and face it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the trapdoor.

Uses inventory_has because when a damaged_anvil is mined with a pickaxe, it drops itself as an item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no damaged_anvil in inventory, so having at least 1 confirms successful mining. This is preferred over count_in_box_at_most(block) because inventory_has directly reflects the mining outcome.

Uses inventory_has because crafting an oak_fence_gate (from 2 oak_planks + 4 sticks) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with no oak_fence_gate, so having at least 1 confirms successful crafting. This is the preferred rule type for craft tasks.
